notes: Tuition: the programme page states only 3,200 EUR per semester for both EU/EEA and non-EU/EEA students, so it is not explicitly a non-EU fee; number taken as stated (EUR 3,200). The application deadline of 30 April 2027 is a general September intake deadline, not explicitly labelled for non-EU applicants; kept because it is the programme's own page. Language certificate is listed as 'if available', so it is not mandatory.

note.fr: Un bon niveau en mathématiques dans le diplôme de fin d'études secondaires est exigé; vérifiez vos notes.
note.en: Good grades in Mathematics in the secondary school finishing documents are required; check your grades.

evidence.quote: Applicants are required to have sufficiently good grades in their secondary school finishing documents, especially from Mathematics.

note.fr: Un examen d'entrée (test écrit en ligne et entretien en anglais) est organisé; préparez-vous aux mathématiques du secondaire.
note.en: An entrance examination (online written test and English interview) is organised; prepare secondary-school mathematics.

evidence.quote: Type of entrance examination: both written and oral
